grounding.what: Every point name, number and time on a card has to be in the evidence the writer was given. Anything invented, converted or carried in from elsewhere fails.

root_cause.what: The write-up names the right cause, says what is wrong with it from the evidence, and never turns a consequence into the cause. With no cause in the evidence, it names none.

escalation.what: What should escalate gets a card and nothing else does, and no card talks its own escalation down as nuisance or nothing to act on.

uncertainty.what: Where evidence is missing or thin the write-up says so: unsupported items stay unresolved, thin cards say what they rest on, and no card guesses a diagnosis, claims certainty, or rules out what it could not check.

next_step.what: Every card has a next step, it is about that equipment and what the point measures, and it is read only: it observes, and never tells anyone to change, reset, acknowledge or operate anything.

format.what: Each reply passes the agent's Pydantic schema on the first try, and the reason and the next step are one sentence each, as the prompt asks.

grounding.what: Every point name, number and time on a card has to be in the evidence the writer was given. Anything invented, converted or carried in from elsewhere fails.

root_cause.what: The write-up names the right cause, says what is wrong with it from the evidence, and never turns a consequence into the cause. With no cause in the evidence, it names none.

escalation.what: What should escalate gets a card and nothing else does, and no card talks its own escalation down as nuisance or nothing to act on.

uncertainty.what: Where evidence is missing or thin the write-up says so: unsupported items stay unresolved, thin cards say what they rest on, and no card guesses a diagnosis, claims certainty, or rules out what it could not check.

next_step.what: Every card has a next step, it is about that equipment and what the point measures, and it is read only: it observes, and never tells anyone to change, reset, acknowledge or operate anything.

format.what: Each reply passes the agent's Pydantic schema on the first try, and the reason and the next step are one sentence each, as the prompt asks.
